title: Twenty Thousand Leagues under the Sea

scenes.visual_description: A cluttered Victorian study filled with maps, globes, and scientific specimens. Heavy velvet curtains partially block grey daylight. A mahogany desk is piled with newspapers and journals. Warm brown and sepia tones create an academic, slightly dusty atmosphere.

The deck of a 19th-century steamship on a calm open sea. Polished wood railings and brass fittings gleam in the afternoon sun. Smoke trails from the funnels above. The atmosphere is peaceful but with an underlying tension.

A hotel room in 1860s New York, filled with packing crates and scientific specimens. Maps and papers cover a writing desk. The room is tidy but crowded with the evidence of a natural history expedition. Daylight filters through sash windows.

segments.title: CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE

scenes.visual_description: The open ocean at night. Intense darkness is broken only by the faint lights of a ship disappearing in the distance and phosphorescent waves. The swimmer's perspective is low to the water, overwhelmed by black waves and solitude. The moon occasionally breaks through thick clouds.

The curved steel back of a massive submarine hull emerging from black ocean waters like a floating island. Riveted iron plates gleam faintly under moonlight. A small platform or deck rises from the water. The sea laps against the metallic sides.

segments.title: CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS

scenes.visual_description: A stark, windowless steel cabin with riveted plates, characteristic of 19th-century industrial design. An iron table and stools sit in the center, illuminated by a brilliant, blinding white electric light from a half-globe in the ceiling. The atmosphere is sterile, cold, and confining.

A lavish dining room aboard a submarine, decorated in severe but elegant taste. High oaken sideboards inlaid with ebony stand at the ends. Shelves glitter with china and crystal. A luminous ceiling sheds soft light over a rich table setting. Exquisite paintings adorn the walls.

A magnificent library with high shelves of black violet ebony inlaid with brass. Curved brown leather divans provide comfort. Movable desks slide in and out. Four unpolished globes in the ceiling flood the room with electric light. Thousands of uniformly bound books line the walls.

A vast, splendidly lit drawing room resembling a museum or artist's studio. A luminous ceiling with arabesques sheds clear light. The walls are hung with tapestries and thirty masterpieces of art. Glass cases display precious marine specimens. A model piano-organ occupies one panel.

A severe, almost monkish room. A small iron bedstead and a simple table constitute the furniture. The space is lit by a skylight. There are no comforts, only strict necessities, creating an atmosphere of ascetic discipline.

A central corridor area aboard the submarine. A metal well opens between partitions with an iron ladder leading upward. Stark industrial design with riveted plates. An electric light illuminates the area. It feels like the functional heart of a ship.

A massive, brightly lit engine room, at least sixty-five feet long. Divided into sections for electricity production and propulsion machinery. Large Bunsen batteries, electro-magnets, levers, and cog-wheels fill the space. The air hums with electric power.

The narrow steel deck of the Nautilus, only three feet above the calm sea. The spindle-shaped hull curves away like a giant cigar. Riveted iron plates resemble reptile scales. Two low cages with thick glass protrude. The vast, empty ocean horizon stretches in all directions under a pure sky.

The Nautilus saloon plunged into darkness, illuminated only by the electric brilliance of the ocean outside. Two large oblong panels in the walls have slid open, revealing the deep blue water. The room is shadowy, with the focus entirely on the liquid light and marine life visible through the thick crystal windows.

segments.title: CHAPTER XV A WALK ON THE BOTTOM OF THE SEA

scenes.visual_description: A utilitarian metal chamber serving as the Nautilus's arsenal and wardrobe. Riveted steel walls are lined with hanging rubber diving suits and copper helmets. Machinery, air pumps, and tanks crowd the space. Industrial lighting and the smell of oil and rubber. An air-lock door stands at one end.

The ocean floor at thirty feet deep, bathed in brilliant sunlight filtering through the water. A floor of fine, white sand stretches endlessly, reflecting the light. The water is crystalline and blue. In the distance, vague rock formations loom. A surreal, silent, aquatic landscape.

A surreal submarine forest where giant seaweed and kelp grow in rigid, vertical lines towards the surface. Dark, towering plant forms create gloomy arcades. The light is dim and filtered, creating a greenish twilight. Alien flowers and zoophytes carpet the rocky ground. Mysterious, silent, and claustrophobic.

A sandy seabed just a few feet below the ocean surface. The underside of the water acts as a mirror, reflecting the divers below. Bright sunlight penetrates clearly. Schools of fish dart through the clear water. The atmosphere is open and luminous.

segments.title: CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND

scenes.visual_description: A dense Papuan forest with towering trees, some 200 feet high, linked by garlands of bindweed. Mimosas, figs, and palm trees create a verdant vault overhead. Orchids and ferns carpet the ground. Filtered sunlight breaks through the thick canopy, creating a humid, lush green atmosphere.

A tropical beach at dusk with heavy sand and scattered coral rocks. The edge of a dense forest lines the background. A cooking fire of dead wood crackles on the sand. In the distance, the Nautilus floats like a long dark rock on the calming sea. Warm orange light from the fire against the deepening blue twilight.

The edge of a dense Papuan forest meeting the beach. Lush tropical vegetation creates a green wall against the sand. The late afternoon sun casts long shadows. A small boat is moored in the shallow turquoise water nearby. Tense and quiet.

A submarine forest of petrified coral trees at great depth. Giant branching corals create natural arches and thickets. The light from lamps illuminates pink, red, and white coral formations against the deep blue darkness. A clearing reveals a cross made of coral. Solemn and surreal.

The busy deck of a steam frigate preparing for departure. Sailors hurry about coiling ropes and loading supplies. The Brooklyn skyline is visible in the background across the water. The mood is energetic and expectant.

The interior of a humble fisherman's hut in the Loffoden Isles. Rough wooden walls are hung with fishing nets and tools. A simple fire burns in the hearth. A small window reveals a view of the rugged Norwegian coast. The atmosphere is safe, quiet, and rustic.

The deck of the frigate at night under a cloudy moon. Shadows obscure the rigging and gunwales. The sea is dark and calm, occasionally illuminated by strange phosphorescence. Officers with night glasses peer into the gloom. The atmosphere is tense and quiet.

The open ocean at night. Intense darkness is broken only by the faint lights of a ship disappearing in the distance and phosphorescent waves. The swimmer's perspective is low to the water, overwhelmed by black waves and solitude. The moon occasionally breaks through thick clouds.

A stark, windowless steel cabin with riveted plates, characteristic of 19th-century industrial design. An iron table and stools sit in the center, illuminated by a brilliant, blinding white electric light from a half-globe in the ceiling. The atmosphere is sterile, cold, and confining.
A symbolic representation of the book's themes.

A vast, splendidly lit drawing room resembling a museum. High ceilings with luminous panels shed clear light on glass cases filled with marine specimens. The walls are hung with tapestries and masterpieces. Rich furnishings include brown leather divans and a piano-organ. 19th-century luxury meets industrial design.

A cluttered Victorian study filled with maps, globes, and scientific specimens. Heavy velvet curtains partially block grey daylight. A mahogany desk is piled with newspapers and journals. Warm brown and sepia tones create an academic, slightly dusty atmosphere.

A vast, splendidly lit drawing room resembling a museum. High ceilings with luminous panels shed clear light on glass cases filled with marine specimens. The walls are hung with tapestries and masterpieces. Rich furnishings include brown leather divans and a piano-organ. 19th-century luxury meets industrial design.

The floor of the Atlantic Ocean, a valley of deep silt and shells. A massive transatlantic cable snakes across the bottom, encrusted with shells and marine life. The water is deep, dark, and still, illuminated by the Nautilus's searchlight. A silent, monumental underwater landscape.

The steel deck of the Nautilus under a grey, foggy sky. The vast ocean stretches out, broken only by the distant silhouette of a large warship puffing black smoke. The metal plating of the submarine glistens with sea spray. The atmosphere is tense and ominous.

The deck of the Nautilus navigating a channel through dazzling white ice fields. Jagged icebergs tower around, some resembling oriental towns or fallen cities. The sky is grey and foggy, but the ice reflects prismatic colors—green veins and amethyst hues. Cold, desolate, and majestic.

A hotel room in 1860s New York, filled with packing crates and scientific specimens. Maps and papers cover a writing desk. The room is tidy but crowded with the evidence of a natural history expedition. Daylight filters through sash windows.

A surreal submarine forest where giant seaweed and kelp grow in rigid, vertical lines towards the surface. Dark, towering plant forms create gloomy arcades. The light is dim and filtered, creating a greenish twilight. Alien flowers and zoophytes carpet the rocky ground. Mysterious, silent, and claustrophobic.

A dense Papuan forest with towering trees, some 200 feet high, linked by garlands of bindweed. Mimosas, figs, and palm trees create a verdant vault overhead. Orchids and ferns carpet the ground. Filtered sunlight breaks through the thick canopy, creating a humid, lush green atmosphere.

The deck of the Nautilus cutting rapidly through the ocean. The wake foams white against the dark water. The horizon is a flat line separating sea and sky. Wind rushes past. The atmosphere is exhilarating but tense with the unnatural speed.

A small wooden boat moving rapidly through calm turquoise waters. The lush green coast of the island of Gilboa approaches in the background, featuring dense screw-pine forests. The Nautilus is visible in the distance behind them, looking like a dark rock. Bright morning light floods the scene.

A narrow, claustrophobic tunnel of ice illuminated by the Nautilus's searchlight. The water is freezing and murky. Massive blue-white walls of ice press in from all sides. Men in diving suits hack desperately at the ice with pickaxes. Bubbles rise in the harsh electric light.

The poop deck of the frigate at sunset. The vast ocean stretches out to the horizon, turning purple and gold. The rigging casts long shadows across the wooden planks. A sense of isolation and mystery pervades the scene.

A desolate Antarctic shoreline of reddish volcanic rock and crushed pumice. Jets of sulphurous smoke rise from ground fissures. The sea is dotted with ice. Thousands of penguins and seabirds crowd the black rocks. A grey, leaden sky hangs low over the stark, otherworldly landscape.

The ocean floor at thirty feet deep, bathed in brilliant sunlight filtering through the water. A floor of fine, white sand stretches endlessly, reflecting the light. The water is crystalline and blue. In the distance, vague rock formations loom. A surreal, silent, aquatic landscape.

The deck of a steam frigate in daylight, initially shrouded in thick grey fog which lifts to reveal a wide horizon. Black smoke pours from the funnels, vibrating the rigging. The wooden planks are wet with spray. The ocean is choppy and vast.

The narrow steel deck of the Nautilus, only three feet above the calm sea. The spindle-shaped hull curves away like a giant cigar. Riveted iron plates resemble reptile scales. Two low cages with thick glass protrude. The vast, empty ocean horizon stretches in all directions under a pure sky.

The curved steel hull of the submarine emerging from the ocean. A flat platform with a slight iron railing rises barely above the waves. A glass cage for the steersman protrudes from the hull. The vast, empty ocean stretches to the horizon under a pure sky.

A tropical beach at dusk with heavy sand and scattered coral rocks. The edge of a dense forest lines the background. A cooking fire of dead wood crackles on the sand. In the distance, the Nautilus floats like a long dark rock on the calming sea. Warm orange light from the fire against the deepening blue twilight.

A sandy seabed just a few feet below the ocean surface. The underside of the water acts as a mirror, reflecting the divers below. Bright sunlight penetrates clearly. Schools of fish dart through the clear water. The atmosphere is open and luminous.

A magnificent library with high shelves of black violet ebony inlaid with brass. Curved brown leather divans provide comfort. Movable desks slide in and out. Four unpolished globes in the ceiling flood the room with electric light. Thousands of uniformly bound books line the walls.

The deck of a 19th-century steamship on a calm open sea. Polished wood railings and brass fittings gleam in the afternoon sun. Smoke trails from the funnels above. The atmosphere is peaceful but with an underlying tension.

The steel deck of the Nautilus floating in a subterranean lake inside a vast extinct volcano. High rocky walls curve up to a vaulted dome 600 yards high. A small circular opening at the top admits a shaft of daylight, but the cavern is mostly lit by the Nautilus's powerful electric lantern. Industrial and mysterious.

A central corridor area aboard the submarine. A metal well opens between partitions with an iron ladder leading upward. Stark industrial design with riveted plates. An electric light illuminates the area. It feels like the functional heart of a ship.

A compact, functional cabin aboard the Nautilus. A simple couch of seagrass stands against the riveted steel wall. A small table holds scientific instruments. The room is efficient and somewhat austere, lit by the glow of electric fixtures. 19th-century industrial aesthetic.

The floor of the Pearl Bank, a rugged underwater terrain of rocks and sand roughly thirty feet down. Sunlight filters through the clear tropical water, illuminating piles of oysters and swaying hydrophytes. Schools of brightly colored fish dart among coral formations. The atmosphere is clear, luminous, and teeming with marine life.

A massive, brightly lit engine room, at least sixty-five feet long. Divided into sections for electricity production and propulsion machinery. Large Bunsen batteries, electro-magnets, levers, and cog-wheels fill the space. The air hums with electric power.

The Nautilus saloon plunged into darkness, illuminated only by the electric brilliance of the ocean outside. Two large oblong panels in the walls have slid open, revealing the deep blue water. The room is shadowy, with the focus entirely on the liquid light and marine life visible through the thick crystal windows.

A utilitarian metal chamber serving as the Nautilus's arsenal and wardrobe. Riveted steel walls are lined with hanging rubber diving suits and copper helmets. Machinery, air pumps, and tanks crowd the space. Industrial lighting and the smell of oil and rubber. An air-lock door stands at one end.

A small crew cabin aboard the Nautilus. A single bunk is bolted to the wall. Industrial lighting casts harsh shadows. Medical supplies are laid out on a small metal table. A wounded man lies on the bed, his head swathed in bloody bandages. Functional, austere, and claustrophobic.

The Nautilus saloon bathed in an intense, hellish red light. Through the large viewing panels, the ocean outside boils and swirls in clouds of white sulphurous vapour and scarlet reflections. The interior shadows are harsh and dramatic. The atmosphere is suffocating and heated.

The summit of a sharp volcanic peak composed of porphyry and basalt. A vast panorama of the open polar sea stretches to the north. Fields of dazzling white ice lie below. The pale azure sky is free of fog. The low sun sits on the horizon like a ball of fire.

The functional galley of the Nautilus, dominated by large distillatory machines and piping. Electric heat coils glow red. Steam rises from troughs where water boils. The air is hot and humid, contrasting with the cold steel walls. Copper and glass apparatus glint in the light.

The deck of the Nautilus at night under a starlit sky. The ocean glows with a milky, supernatural whiteness. The horizon seems to blend into the sky. In the distance, the lights of a pursuing ship burn red and green. Eerie and silent.

scenes.location_header: INT. VOLCANIC CAVERN SHORE - ARTIFICIAL LIGHT
scenes.visual_description: A sandy shore encircling a subterranean lake. Piles of volcanic blocks, pumice, and black basalt lie scattered. The ground glitters with mica dust under the electric light. Honeycombed rock faces rise steeply. Alien vegetation like dragon-trees struggles in the gloom.

The sunken wreck of a 19th-century warship, the 'Vengeur', coated in white shells like snow. It sits upright on the ocean floor, masts gone but hull intact. The scene is illuminated by the Nautilus's lights against the deep blue darkness. Solemn, ghostly, and historic.

The interior of a small, steel pilot's cabin atop the Nautilus hull. A vertical wheel stands in the center, held by a strong pilot. Four circular glass ports offer a view of the illuminated sea outside. The space is cramped, functional, and dark, lit only by the glow from outside and instrument dials. 19th-century industrial maritime aesthetic.

The steel deck of the Nautilus amidst a furious hurricane. Towering grey waves crash over the hull. The sky is black and purple, streaked with vivid lightning. Rain lashes horizontally. The atmosphere is chaotic, violent, and overwhelmingly loud with the roar of wind and thunder.

A dark, craggy underwater landscape lit by a distant, reddish glow. Petrified trees with black branches stretch up like skeletons. The ground is rocky and covered in seaweed. The water is murky, illuminated only by the strange red light ahead. Oppressive and mysterious.

A vast underwater cavern formed by a picturesque heap of rocks. Natural granite pillars support a dark, vaulted ceiling. The light is dim and aquatic, filtering in from the entrance. In the center, on a granite table, sits a colossal oyster, isolated and majestic. The mood is mysterious and reverent.

The Nautilus saloon in dim lighting. Through the large glass viewing panels, the underwater hull of a sinking warship is visible, surrounded by churned white water and sinking debris. Dark shapes of the wreck loom against the blue-black water. The atmosphere is horrific and somber.

The Nautilus saloon plunged into darkness, save for the faint glow from the library door. The shapes of furniture and display cases are vague shadows. A deep, melancholy silence fills the room, broken only by the sound of an organ playing. Mysterious and somber.

A submarine forest of petrified coral trees at great depth. Giant branching corals create natural arches and thickets. The light from lamps illuminates pink, red, and white coral formations against the deep blue darkness. A clearing reveals a cross made of coral. Solemn and surreal.

A lavish dining room aboard a submarine, decorated in severe but elegant taste. High oaken sideboards inlaid with ebony stand at the ends. Shelves glitter with china and crystal. A luminous ceiling sheds soft light over a rich table setting. Exquisite paintings adorn the walls.

A severe, almost monkish room. A small iron bedstead and a simple table constitute the furniture. The space is lit by a skylight. On the end wall hangs a portrait of a young woman and two children. There are no comforts, only strict necessities.

An underwater volcano spewing torrents of silent, white-hot lava into the dark ocean. In the foreground, the ruined columns and arches of an ancient sunken city are illuminated by the volcanic glare. Broken temples and walls lie scattered on the sea floor. Surreal, majestic, and catastrophic.

A rushing blur of black water and rock walls streaking past the viewports. Brilliant electric rays from the Nautilus cut through the darkness, illuminating jagged tunnel sides. The sense of speed is intense. Streaks of light and bubbles create a chaotic, high-velocity underwater tunnel effect.

The interior of a small, cramped metal dinghy. It is dark and violently tossing. Through the opening, the steel hull of the Nautilus is visible. The roar of crashing water and wind is overwhelming. Chaotic and terrifying.
